title: Strat-LLM: Stratified Strategy Alignment for LLM-based Stock Trading with Real-time Multi-Source Signals
central_strategy: For each decision date, combine sequential prices, real-time news, and annual reports into an LLM state; prompt the model in Free, Guided, or Strict mode relative to four expert strategy motifs; emit buy, hold, or sell plus rationale; and execute the action at the next-day open in a rolling broker simulation.
headline_selection_boundary: The paper studies how constraint mode interacts with model architecture and market regime; it does not nominate one model/mode as a universal default. Selecting the highest displayed U.S. return after seeing Table 1 would be outcome-based specification choice rather than a source-fixed headline recipe.

required_but_missing: A source-selected model and interaction mode, exact prompts, structured response schema, sampling configuration, retries, and immutable model requests/responses.
The stock lists, exact short-window dates, point-in-time minute prices, real-time news, annual reports, timestamps, preprocessing, and data snapshots.
Complete S1-S4 operational rules; only S2 supplies one numeric entry condition, while exits, sizes, thresholds, tie rules, and the other three strategy definitions remain incomplete.
The buy-volume rule, transaction-cost schedule, slippage, shorting/leverage, corporate actions, portfolio aggregation, and broker implementation.
Security-date actions, orders, fills, cash, holdings, NAV/return arrays, metric formulas, seeds, and raw result arrays.
monthly_jkp_assessment.why_s2_is_not_a_headline_partial: The 3-day-high S2 entry is one incomplete clause in a four-strategy library. It omits price-field, exit, sizing, and tie rules and cannot reproduce the Strict multi-strategy policy or the LLM's multi-source action selection.
monthly_jkp_assessment.why_procedure_component_is_insufficient: The synthetic T+1/action-mapping check validates only a conditional timing convention and cash truncation with a researcher-set zero cost; it uses no paper inputs, model, broker, action, or return.
monthly_jkp_assessment.why_jkp_cannot_fill_the_gap: JKP supplies monthly U.S. characteristics and returns, not the paper's intraday prices, news, reports, prompts, or LLM decisions. Mapping a generic momentum or reversal factor to S1-S4 would replace the central alignment experiment.
monthly_jkp_assessment.temporal_claim_boundary: All ten displayed model identities or families became public after at least part of the claimed 2025 live-forward windows, and eight first appeared in 2026. A post-hoc chronological replay could avoid look-ahead, but no frozen inputs, request times, or actions were released to verify it.
monthly_jkp_assessment.reported_us_result_context: Every displayed U.S. total return is negative; GPT-5.4 Strict is least negative at -0.40%, but choosing it as the recipe from the result table would be post-outcome selection and still would not recover its actions.

closure_rule: Do not promote the synthetic timing check, isolated 3-day-high clause, post-outcome best model/mode, or generic JKP momentum/reversal proxies to Strat-LLM. Reopen for attributable prompts, frozen data, actions/holdings, or an executable release.
